title: DSABench: Benchmarking Source Discovery, Coordination, and Execution for Multi-Database Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most text-to-SQL benchmarks provide the target database. In a large data catalog, however, choosing the sources is part of the problem: an agent must find every database needed for a request, determine how their results fit together, and execute the resulting workflow. We present DSABench to evaluate these capabilities jointly. Its 815 human-reviewed tasks draw on Spider, BIRD, and LiveSQLBench; 618 require several databases to contribute, and 105 allow more than one interpretation of the required sources. Executable contracts define source participation, cross-source dependencies, and source-local execution, while RouteEnv lets agents inspect public catalog evidence without revealing the gold annotations. In our routing-only study across seven model backends, the highest RA-Set score is 60.55%, compared with a highest RA-Graph score of 34.66% when coordination requirements are included. translated_title: DSABench：面向多数据库智能体的数据源发现、协调与执行能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 大多数text-to-SQL基准测试都会提供目标数据库。然而，在一个大型数据目录中，选择数据源本身就是问题的一部分：智能体必须找到请求所需的每个数据库，确定各数据库的结果如何相互配合，并执行由此产生的工作流。我们提出了DSABench来联合评估这些能力。其815个经人工审核的任务来自Spider、BIRD和LiveSQLBench；其中618个任务需要多个数据库共同参与，105个任务对所需数据源存在多种合理解释。可执行契约定义了数据源参与、跨数据源依赖以及源内本地执行，而RouteEnv则允许智能体在不泄露黄金标注的情况下检查公共目录证据。在针对七个模型后端的纯路由研究中，最高的RA-Set得分为60.55%，而当纳入协调要求时，最高的RA-Graph得分仅为34.66%。当执行（环节被引入时），这一差距变得更加明显。
tldr: DSABench是首个联合评估多数据库智能体在数据源发现、跨源协调与工作流执行三方面能力的基准测试，其815个人工审核任务的实验显示，引入协调要求后最强模型成绩从60.55%骤降至34.66%，揭示了现有模型在多数据库场景下的巨大能力缺口。
en_tdlr: DSABench is the first benchmark to jointly evaluate multi-database agents on source discovery, coordination, and workflow execution, whose 815 human-reviewed tasks reveal a dramatic performance drop from 60.55% to 34.66% when coordination requirements are introduced, exposing a substantial capability gap in current models.
